title: GradingAdjudication
description: The joint-read verdict for one task (SPEC-confirmation-run.md §6.6.3): the verdict the study USES, recorded by an admin after the readers' independent rows are frozen. The readers' own rows are never modified by it — the pre-adjudication κ is the one reported, and it needs the originals. One current row per task; a re-save bumps `version`.

verdict.description: The adjudicated pair-level verdict, same vocabulary as a reader's.

span_judgements.description: Adjudicated per-span judgements, same addressing as a reader's. Empty when not recorded.

notes.description: How the disagreement was resolved. Exported verbatim as the `_ADJ.csv` `notes` column.

adjudicated_by.description: Subject of the admin who saved this version.

version.description: 1 on the first save for this task; +1 on every re-save.

saved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this version.
